cardChanges.verification: Current pairing confirmed by UFC event page and ESPN; UFC preview explicitly describes short-notice replacement. No unverified injury detail added.

sourcePolicy: ESPN official API supplies all 24 observed W/L/D/NC records, all KO/TKO and submission totals, all 48 bout outcomes and methods.
UFC official event page controls pairing, English fighter names, card section and order; its snapshot matches ESPN.
Two documented professional-only record overrides exclude TUF house exhibitions; original ESPN observations are retained.
Completed professional fights only: do not count scheduled, cancelled, exhibition, kickboxing, grappling or BJJ bouts.
KO and TKO are normalized to KO/TKO; no disputed granular knockout subtype is invented.
Historical UFC dates use the official US card date, not the UTC date of a late-night bout; regional listed calendar dates are retained.
ESPN incomplete regional event lists are not sufficient evidence for headliners: LFA 223/226, Fury 116, FCR27 and Samourai12 were checked separately.
Search results from newsespn.pages.dev are not an official ESPN source and were not used as evidence.

limitations.selected: Current UFC event page and ESPN event API agree on 5 main-card / 7 preliminary bouts and the same order.
limitations.alternatives: The October 26 UFC preview instead places Reese vs Gall on a six-bout main card and puts Santos vs Santos above Osbourne vs Durden.
limitations.resolution: Use the matching canonical UFC event page and ESPN live snapshot; retain the editorial discrepancy for owner review.

limitations.selected: 12-0-0; 4 KO/TKO, 5 submission, 3 decision. ESPN lists twelve wins; OKTAGON lists 12-0, and 7sport independently reports the 4/5/3 split.
limitations.alternatives: Sherdog and the October 26 UFC preview show 10-0, 3 KO/TKO and 4 submissions. The UFC athlete profile is an incomplete 0-0 placeholder.
limitations.resolution: Keep ESPN/promoter values. ESPN includes two 2019 OKTAGON Challenge qualification wins absent from Sherdog; no unsupported reclassification is made.

limitations.selected: Professional-only 8-2-0; 4 KO/TKO, 3 submission, 1 decision, corroborated by Sherdog and Tapology.
limitations.alternatives: ESPN overall 9-2 includes the TUF house semifinal win; UFC shows 9-2 with 4 KO/TKO, 2 submission and 3 decision.
limitations.resolution: Exclude the TUF house exhibition. Nevada commission labels the Sezinando vs Creighton contest an exhibition. Preserve the published-provider discrepancy; the last two professional fights are Donchenko and Ramsay.

limitations.selected: Professional-only 31-13-0, matching Sherdog. Victory breakdown remains 12 KO/TKO, 14 submissions, 5 decisions.
limitations.alternatives: ESPN and UFC show 31-14; the ESPN ledger includes the TUF 22 semifinal loss to Artem Lobov.
limitations.resolution: Exclude the TUF exhibition loss, explicitly classified as exhibition by Sherdog and Tapology. No professional loss has been removed without a documented classification.

limitations.alternatives: UFC shows 6-0 and 4 KO/TKO. Sherdog classifies the 2022 Ibragim Sariev win as an exhibition; Tapology calls that bout professional.
limitations.resolution: Retain the requested primary ESPN values. The classification disagreement is not conclusively resolved by a commission record.

limitations.selected: ESPN, UFC and Sherdog: 6 KO/TKO, 4 submissions, 3 decisions.
limitations.resolution: Use the concordant ESPN/UFC values and retain the alternate method classification. The latest Idiris bout is independently recorded as NO_CONTEST in ESPN and Sherdog, not a loss.

requiredChanges: Define UFC-only versus all-professional scope and treatment of NC/draw; lastTwoFights alone cannot establish longer streaks.
Add an optional nullable integer to Fighter in MmaModels.kt, with parser/toJson support and nonnegative validation in EventValidator.kt and both Python validators.
Add UI display and old-payload/unknown-value tests; confirm existing Android/web clients before making the field required.
Keep research evidence in existing sources/verification. A required incompatible change would need explicit schema/version planning.

publication.requirement: Resolve all source conflicts, or obtain explicit owner acceptance of these exact documented limitations bound to the final candidate SHA. Use existing approvals/*.json only after actual owner consent.
